lines.en: Far away — where the grass is greener////
lines.zh: : 遥远之地——那里的草更绿////

lines.en: Two young girls were spending their afternoon sitting beside one another, shielded from the cruelty of the world in this fortress of an apartment complex.
lines.zh: : 两个小女孩正共度午后,彼此挨着,在这座公寓楼筑成的堡垒里,躲开了世界的残酷。

lines.en: The only problem is that one of them had already been exposed to the cruelty of the world just a couple nights ago when a large man decided to use her room as a love hotel while she was still inside.
lines.zh: : 唯一的问题是:几天前,其中一个已经接触过世界的残酷——一个大块头男人决定把她的房间当情人旅馆,而她当时还在屋里。

lines.en: She hadn’t been able to stop thinking about this ever since it happened. None of the thoughts were good, though.
lines.zh: : 从那件事发生起,她就没法停止去想。虽然没有一个念头是好的。

lines.en: As a matter of fact, none of them were really bad either. They were just thoughts. Confusion. Nothing more.
lines.zh: : 事实上,也没有一个念头是真的坏。它们只是念头。困惑。仅此而已。

lines.en: So as she lay there beside a friend, she decided to keep her mouth shut. At least for now.
lines.zh: : 所以,当她躺在朋友身边时,她决定闭紧嘴巴。至少暂时如此。

lines.en: But as she gazed down at a line of arithmetic she’d been using to distract herself, she thought of something to distract her from that.
lines.zh: : 可当她低头盯着那行用来转移注意力的算术题时,她想到了另一件能转移注意力的事。

lines.en: She remembered the sounds. Those slapping, wet sounds. Like a slab of meat being thrown onto the table and tenderized by the hands of an inexperienced chef.
lines.zh: : 她想起了那些声音。那些啪啪的、湿漉漉的声音。像一整块肉被摔上案板、被一个生手厨师反复捶打。

lines.en: Maybe she should speak up? Maybe Chinami had seen something similar? Maybe she would better understand exactly what was happening if she was asked to weigh in?
lines.zh: : 也许她该说出来?也许 Chinami 见过类似的?也许让她来分析,她就能更明白那到底是怎么回事?

lines.en: Which isn’t to say Tsukasa didn’t understand. She was a smart girl. But there’s a distinct difference between just hearing about open heart surgery and then seeing it with your own eyes.
lines.zh: : 这不是说她不懂。她是个聪明的女孩。但「听说开心脏手术」和「亲眼看见开心脏手术」,有本质的区别。

lines.en: There are parts that someone without any training just won’t understand. It’ll look scary. Confusing. Gross. And it is. But it is because it’s supposed to be. Just like that thing she saw!
lines.zh: : 有些部分,没有任何训练的人就是不会懂。它看起来会很吓人。很困惑。很恶心。而它确实如此。但它「就应该」如此。就像她看到的那件事!

lines.en: What was it called again? Sex? That was the word, right? She remembered the word. And she remembered something about penises and vaginas. How boys and girls have different parts. That she knew.
lines.zh: : 那叫什么来着?性?是那个词吧?她记得那个词。还记着一些关于 penis 和阴道的事。男孩和女孩的部位不一样。这个她知道。

lines.en: But then those memories of the sounds came back. Followed by the memories of the way Jeeves handled that loud woman’s body. Tsukasa had never even been that rough with her stuffed animals before.
lines.zh: : 可那些声音的记忆又回来了。接着是 Jeeves 摆弄那个大嗓门女人身体的画面。Tsukasa 连对自己的毛绒玩具,都从来没那么粗暴过。

lines.en: : Mmm...

She lets out a sound on accident. Not to be confused with the sounds that loud woman let out on purpose. She felt good, right? She didn’t seem like she was in pain. But it didn’t look particularly fun and-
lines.zh: : 她不小心发出了声音。别和那个大嗓门女人「故意」发出的声音搞混。她很舒服,对吧?看起来不像是在疼。但那看起来也不怎么有趣,而且——

lines.en: : Is something wrong, Tsukasa?
lines.zh: : 怎么了,Tsukasa?

lines.en: Good. Now she didn’t have to be alone with her thoughts anymore. All she had to do was not mention sex and-
lines.zh: : 太好了。这下她不必独自面对那些念头了。她只需要不提性,然后——

lines.en: : Chinami, what do you know about sex?
lines.zh: : Chinami,关于性,你都知道些什么?

lines.en: Mission failed immediately. Her curiosity had once more gotten the best of her.
lines.zh: : 任务当场失败。她的好奇心再一次占了上风。

lines.en: : Wh...What?!
: Sex. It’s when a man and a woman-
lines.zh: : 性。就是男人和女人——

lines.en: : Chinami knows what it is! She’s seen it on TV! She just wants to know why you’re asking something so mature!
lines.zh: : Chinami 知道那是什么!她在电视上看过!她只是想知道,你为什么会问这么成熟的问题!

lines.en: : You remember that we had your sister’s Christmas party at my house this year, right?
lines.zh: : 你记得今年你姐姐的圣诞派对,是在我家办的,对吧?

lines.en: : Of course Chinami remembers! She wanted to go but had to stay home alone because the outside world hates her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 当然记得!她想去,却只能一个人留在家里,因为外面的世界恨她。

lines.en: : Well, I may have...seen something.
lines.zh: : 嗯,我可能……看到了什么。

lines.en: : Mm...Big sis Chika has been going kinda crazy lately. Chinami thinks she wants Papa to love her more. So if you saw them together-
lines.zh: : 嗯……Chika 大姐最近有点疯。Chinami 觉得她是想让爸爸多爱她一点。所以如果你看到他们俩在一起——

lines.en: : Your sister wasn’t involved. It was Jeeves and some other woman.
lines.zh: : 你姐姐没有参与。是 Jeeves 和另一个女人。

lines.en: : PAPA, NO!
lines.zh: : 爸爸,不!

lines.en: : Have you learned about that stuff yet, Chinami? Or, better yet, have you seen your sister and Jeeves do it together?
lines.zh: : 你学过那些东西了吗,Chinami?或者,更好一点,你见过你姐姐和 Jeeves 一起做吗?

lines.en: : No! They don’t do that stuff in here! Or at least...not while Chinami is awake! She can’t confirm or deny what happens when she’s sleeping!
lines.zh: : 没有!他们不会在这里做那些!至少……不在 Chinami 醒着的时候!她睡着之后发生的事,她既不能证实也不能否认!

lines.en: : I see, I see.
lines.zh: : 我懂了,懂了。

lines.en: : Oh well. Carry on then, I suppose.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那就当无事发生,我猜。

lines.en: : Y...Yeah. Chinami will...carry on.
lines.zh: : 好……好。Chinami 会……当无事发生的。

lines.en: And so the two of them went back to their books. One continued to fiddle with numbers while the other was neck-deep in a fight sequence between some green guy and some orange guy.
lines.zh: : 于是两人重新看起书来。一个继续摆弄数字,另一个一头扎进绿皮人和橙皮人的打斗戏里。

lines.en: She forgot their names. It was hard to focus at the moment.
lines.zh: : 她忘了他们的名字。眼下很难集中精神。

lines.en: They stayed like this for quite some time.
lines.zh: : 她们就这样待了相当久。

lines.en: : What do you think it feels like?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那是什么感觉?

lines.en: : Tsukasa!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa!

lines.en: Until they didn’t.
lines.zh: : 直到她们没能继续。

lines.en: : Is something the matter?
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗?

lines.en: : Yes! We’re not supposed to talk about this kind of stuff! Stop trying to turn Chinami into a bad girl!
lines.zh: : 出事了!我们不许聊这种东西!别想把 Chinami 变成坏女孩!

lines.en: : But now is the perfect time to discuss topics we’d otherwise be banned from since there’s no one around to tell us we can’t. It’s just like when I give you insider trading tips.
lines.zh: : 可现在正是聊「平时被禁止的话题」的完美时机——周围没有人来禁止我们。就像我给你内幕交易贴士的时候一样。

lines.en: : Those are for Chinami’s secret 401k! She makes an exception for them since they directly impact her future!
lines.zh: : 那是给 Chinami 的秘密 401k 的!那些是例外,因为它们直接影响她的未来!

lines.en: : Fine. I guess you’re just not mature enough to handle such an adult discussion then.
lines.zh: : 行。我猜你就是不够成熟,应付不了这种成人讨论了。

lines.en: : Chinami guesses so too. And that is fine with her.
lines.zh: : Chinami 也这么猜。而且她完全接受。

lines.en: : I guess we’ll just go back to our books then.
lines.zh: : 那我们就回去看书吧。

lines.en: : Chinami is way ahead of you...
lines.zh: : Chinami 已经领先你一大截了……

lines.en: : It looked kind of scary.
lines.zh: : 那看起来有点吓人。

lines.en: : If you’re trying to kill Chinami, at least do it with peanuts!
lines.zh: : 你要是想弄死 Chinami,至少用花生!

lines.en: : Penis?
lines.zh: : Penis?

lines.en: : Don’t pretend you didn’t actually hear what Chinami said!
lines.zh: : 别装作你真没听到 Chinami 刚才说的话!

lines.en: : I don’t know what else to do! I don’t want to tell my mom or my sister because they’ll probably get mad at Jeeves! And I don’t want to ask Jeeves because...I feel like I...wasn’t supposed to see that.
lines.zh: : 我不知道还能怎么办!我不想告诉我妈或我姐,因为她们多半会迁怒于 Jeeves!我也不想问 Jeeves,因为……我觉得我……不该看到那些。

lines.en: : Did you go somewhere you weren’t supposed to?
lines.zh: : 你去了不该去的地方?

lines.en: : Oh, no. They did it in my room.
lines.zh: : 哦,不。是他们在「我」房间里做的。

lines.en: : PAPA, NO!
lines.zh: : 爸爸,不!

lines.en: : She’s not going to have a baby now, is she?
lines.zh: : 她现在不会怀孕了吧?

lines.en: : I...uhh...Chinami...doesn’t think so?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……Chinami……觉得不会?

lines.en: : She thinks that...there are ways to prevent it? Otherwise she’d have a million little sisters by now.
lines.zh: : 她觉得……有办法预防吧?不然到现在她该有一百万个妹妹了。

lines.en: : A million? You think they do it that much?
lines.zh: : 一百万?你觉得他们做得那么勤?

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t want to know how many times they do it!
lines.zh: : Chinami 不想知道他们做多少次!

lines.en: : Really? Why?
lines.zh: : 真的吗?为什么?

lines.en: : Because...she doesn’t. That’s Chinami’s dad. It’s gross. Also, why were they in your room?!
lines.zh: : 因为……她不想。那是 Chinami 的爸爸。恶心。另外,他们为什么在你的房间?!

lines.en: : Jeeves probably just remembered how exceptional the atmosphere was and wanted to impress that woman. Some sort of mating ritual perhaps?
lines.zh: : Jeeves 多半只是想起那里的氛围有多特别,想在那位女士面前露一手。某种求偶仪式?

lines.en: : Oh. Maybe that’s why they don’t do it in Chinami’s house then. Your house sounds better.
lines.zh: : 哦。也许这就是他们不在 Chinami 家做的原因。你家听起来更好。

lines.en: : It is better. But that’s beside the point, Chinami.
lines.zh: : 确实更好。但那是题外话,Chinami。

lines.en: : Well, what is the point?! Because Chinami is feeling very confused and very flustered right now and still thinks we shouldn’t be talking about this!
lines.zh: : 那重点是什么?!因为 Chinami 现在非常困惑、非常慌乱,而且依然觉得我们不该聊这个!

lines.en: : It’s merely a bodily function. And surely the two of us will also be doing things like that one day. Wouldn’t it make more sense to understand them now so we’re not confused when that time comes?
lines.zh: : 那只是一种身体机能。而且 Surely 我们俩有一天也会做那样的事。现在先搞懂它,免得到时候一头雾水,不是更合理吗?

lines.en: : Chinami is never going to do stuff like that because Chinami never leaves the house.
lines.zh: : Chinami 永远不会做那种事,因为 Chinami 从来不出门。

lines.en: : Maybe Jeeves will do it with you if you ask politely?
lines.zh: : 也许你礼貌地开口,Jeeves 就会和你做?

lines.en: : GET OUT OF CHINAMI’S HOUSE! PAPA WOULD NEVER! EVEN IF HE IS A LOLICON!
lines.zh: : 滚出 CHINAMI 的家!爸爸绝对不会!哪怕他是个萝莉控!

lines.en: : What’s a lolicon?
lines.zh: : 什么是萝莉控?

lines.en: : SOMEONE WHO WOULD STAND OUTSIDE OF THE DOOR AND LISTEN TO THIS CONVERSATION WITH A WEIRD SMILE ON THEIR FACE!
lines.zh: : 那种「会站在门外、带着诡异的微笑听完这段对话」的人!

lines.en: : Chinami! I’m home!
lines.zh: : Chinami!我回来了!

lines.en: : SISTER, NO!
lines.zh: : 姐姐,别过来!

lines.en: : Oh, Tsukasa. You’re here too.
lines.zh: : 哦,Tsukasa。你也在啊。

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Shhhhh! Don’t say any of that stuff in front of Big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 嘘————!这些话千万别在 Chika 大姐面前说!

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Why not? She possesses the information that both of us lack. We can become sex experts with her guidance.
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 为什么不行?她掌握着我们俩都缺的信息。在她的指导下,我们能变成性爱专家。

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Chinami doesn’t want to be a sex expert! She wants to read her manga and find out if the green guy beats the orange guy before Big Sis Yumi takes it back!
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ Chinami 不想当性爱专家!她只想看漫画,查清楚绿皮人到底有没有打赢橙皮人——趁 Yumi 大姐把书收回去之前!

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Do you think Big Sis Yumi is having sex with Jeeves too?
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 你觉得 Yumi 大姐也在和 Jeeves 做吗?

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ No! But between us, I definitely think she wants to.
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 不!但只在我们之间说,我绝对觉得她想。

lines.en: : Why do I feel like there’s a whole lot of telepathic communication going on right now?
lines.zh: : 为什么我感觉这里正在进行大规模的心灵感应?

lines.en: : Chika, can I ask you a question about something?
lines.zh: : Chika,我能问你一个问题吗?

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Please don’t! Chinami feels like you’re about to make her life a whole lot more difficult! And it’s already too hard for her!
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 求你别问!Chinami 感觉你马上要让她的生活难上加难!而她现在已经够难了!

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ Don’t worry. I won’t tell her it was Jeeves. I don’t want that woman to be murdered.
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 放心。我不会说那个男人是 Jeeves。我可不想那位女士被杀。

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ That only kind of helps!
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 那只是「有一点」用!

lines.en: : I still feel like there’s some telepathy going on here, but sure. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 我还是觉得你们在进行心灵感应,不过行。怎么了?

lines.en: : What does “sex” feel like?
lines.zh: : 「性」是什么感觉?

lines.en: : What does...what?! Where did you hear that word?!
lines.zh: : 什么……什么?!你从哪听来这个词的?!

lines.en: : Hah...
: I was watching one of the presentations my family provides about the reproductive system this morning, but it lacked real world context that I believe would enhance the experience.
lines.zh: : 我今天上午看了我们家族提供的生殖系统宣讲,但它缺少真实世界的语境——而我相信那会让体验更完整。

lines.en: : Then...ask your mom?
lines.zh: : 那……问你妈妈?

lines.en: : My mom hates me now. You’re my only hope.
lines.zh: : 我妈妈现在恨我。你是我唯一的希望。

lines.en: : What? Tsukasa, your mom does not hate you. She loves you very much. Parenting is just...complicated sometimes. But I’m sure she’d gladly help you if you asked her about this.
lines.zh: : 什么?Tsukasa,你妈妈不恨你。她非常爱你。为人父母只是……有时候很复杂。但我确信,你开口问她,她乐意帮忙。

lines.en: : Can’t you just tell me? I know now that’s what you and Jeeves were doing when you played that really loud game at the onsen.
lines.zh: : 你就不能直接告诉我吗?我现在知道了——你们在温泉里玩那个超吵的游戏时,做的就是这个。

lines.en: : Jeeves?
lines.zh: : Jeeves?

lines.en: : She’s...talking about Papa...
lines.zh: : 她……说的是爸爸……

lines.en: : I know who she’s talking about. I’ve only gone on one onsen trip. There’s no way I could ever afford to actually pay to stay in a place like that. And I don’t win radio contests often. Probably since it’s 2020.
lines.zh: : 我知道她说的是谁。我只去过一次温泉旅行。我绝对付不起住那种地方的钱。而且我也不常赢电台竞赛。大概因为都 2020 年了。

lines.en: : Just tell me — on a scale of one to a thousand, how good does it feel?
lines.zh: : 直接告诉我——从一到一千,它有多爽?

lines.en: : Two thousand.
lines.zh: : 两千。

lines.en: : That’s so high! No wonder you and that other woman were so loud!
lines.zh: : 那么高!难怪你和那个女人那么吵!

lines.en: : What other woman?!
lines.zh: : 哪个女人?!

lines.en: : From...the presentation I watched, obviously!
lines.zh: : 显然是……我看的那场宣讲里的!

lines.en: : Tsukasa, since I’m only your honorary sister at this point and not an actual one, I’m going to keep this lesson extremely brief.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa,鉴于我现在只是你的「荣誉姐姐」、不是亲姐姐,这一课我会讲得极其简短。

lines.en: : Sex feels good because it’s all about establishing a connection with someone you really care about. When that happens, it’s one of the most amazing feelings in the world.
lines.zh: : 性之所以感觉好,是因为它是在和「你真正在乎的人」建立联结。当那种联结发生时,它是世界上最美好的感觉之一。

lines.en: : And sure there are...other contexts where it isn’t technically about that. But you are way too young to be getting involved with that stuff, so don’t even worry about that part for now.
lines.zh: : 当然,也……有其他语境,严格来说与这个无关。但你还太小,不该卷入那些,所以现在连想都不用想那部分。

lines.en: : I’m not involved! I only watched! I’m just curious. That’s all.
lines.zh: : 我没有卷入!我只是看了!我只是好奇。就这样。

lines.en: : Watched...the presentation right? That your family put on?
lines.zh: : 看了……那场宣讲,对吧?你们家族办的?

lines.en: : Hm? Oh. Yes. Presentation.
lines.zh: : 嗯?哦。对。宣讲。

lines.en: : So you promise you’re not going to command one of your henchmen to teach you?
lines.zh: : 所以你保证,不会命令你的哪个手下来教你?

lines.en: : Ew! Those guys?! I barely consider them human! If I was going to do it with anyone it’d be-
lines.zh: : 恶心!那种人?!我根本不把他们当人类!真要找个人做,那也是——

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ DON’T YOU DARE MENTION ANY OF MY PAPA’S NAMES!
lines.zh: : 用巫术进行心灵感应 ~ 你敢提「我爸爸」的任何一个名字试试!

lines.en: : American movie star, Seth Rogen!
lines.zh: : 美国电影明星,Seth Rogen!

lines.en: : Communicating telepathically through wizard powers ~ ?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!?!
: You too?...Seriously?...
lines.zh: : 你也是?……认真的?……

lines.en: : You and your sister both. I just...what?
lines.zh: : 你和你姐姐都是。我只是……什么?

lines.en: : I...like his laugh?
lines.zh: : 我……喜欢他的笑?

lines.en: : Tsukasa...don’t. Just don’t. Ask me again in like thirty years if you’re still curious, okay? Until then, just...do wizard stuff.
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……别。千万别。如果你三十年后还好奇,再来问我,好吗?在那之前,你就……玩你的巫术。

lines.en: : Chinami! I’m going to start the bath. Is it okay if I go first today? I have plans in a couple hours and need time to do my makeup again.
lines.zh: : Chinami!我去放洗澡水了。今天我先洗可以吗?我几个小时后有安排,需要时间重新化妆。

lines.en: : Of course, big sis Chika! Anything for you, big sis Chika! I love you, big sis Chika!
lines.zh: : 当然,Chika 大姐!为 Chika 大姐赴汤蹈火!我爱你,Chika 大姐!

lines.en: : You, though...
lines.zh: : 至于你……

lines.en: : I hope you enjoy your stay on Chinami’s shit list...
lines.zh: : 祝你在 Chinami 的黑名单上住得愉快……

lines.en: : Chinami! You know we’re not allowed to say bad words.
lines.zh: : Chinami!我们不许说脏话的,你知道吧。

lines.en: : Sex is a bad word, darn it!
lines.zh: : 「性」就是脏话, darn it!

lines.en: : It is?!
lines.zh: : 它是吗?!

lines.en: : Probably! And even if it’s not, it is in this house! Especially when it’s in relation to Papa!
lines.zh: : 多半是!就算不是,在这个家里就是!尤其当它和爸爸有关的时候!

lines.en: : Fine. But one day, you’re going to become a woman like me who has witnessed firsthand a bond between lovers and/or very good friends. And when that day comes, Chinami...I will not be there to help you.
lines.zh: : 好吧。但总有一天,你也会长成我这样的女人——亲眼见证过恋人、或非常好的朋友之间的羁绊。等到那一天,Chinami……我不会在那里帮你的。

lines.en: : Chinami sure hopes so because she feels like something really bad would need to happen for us to both witness such a thing at the same time.
lines.zh: : Chinami 真心希望如此,因为她觉得,要让我们俩「同时」见证那种事,得先出天大的坏事。

lines.en: : It’s not as bad as you make it sound, you know. It was kind of just...weird. But also interesting.
lines.zh: : 没有你说的那么糟啦。其实就……有点怪。但也挺有意思。

lines.en: : It didn’t last very long, though.
lines.zh: : 不过它没持续多久就是了。

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t know why, but she feels like you’re insulting her dad right now.
lines.zh: : Chinami 不知道为什么,但她觉得你这是在侮辱她爸。

lines.en: : Do you think I should tell him I saw his secret tryst? Or would that be unbecoming of a lady like me?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我该告诉他,我看到他的秘密幽会了吗?还是说,那样有失我这种淑女的身份?

lines.en: : Why would you tell him?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要告诉他?

lines.en: : To use it against him as blackmail, of course. What kind of fool do you take me for?
lines.zh: : 当然是留着当把柄。你把我当什么傻子?

lines.en: : The fool who almost made Chinami get “the talk.” Chinami’s avoided the talk forever. You put her streak in jeopardy.
lines.zh: : 当「差点让 Chinami 上『那一课』」的傻子。Chinami 从来没上过那一课。你把她的纪录置于危险之中。

lines.en: : What’s this “talk” you speak of? There are many talks in relation to reproductive health. But each one is conducted by a separate-
lines.zh: : 你说的「那一课」是什么?关于生殖健康,有许多次谈话。但每一次都由单独的——

lines.en: : No, Tsukasa. “The talk” is what we peasants call it when our parents or guardians teach us about naughty stuff. We don’t get special presentations or anything like that.
lines.zh: : 不,Tsukasa。「那一课」是我们平民的说法——爸妈或监护人给我们讲那些下流知识的时候。我们没有专门的宣讲之类的。

lines.en: : Then how do you even know about “the talk” before receiving the talk?
lines.zh: : 那你在接受「那一课」之前,怎么连「那一课」都知道?

lines.en: : Everybody learns about “the talk” before getting “the talk.” That’s part of “the talk.”
lines.zh: : 每个人在接受「那一课」之前,都会先知道「那一课」。这也是「那一课」的一部分。

lines.en: : This sounds like a rather convoluted talk to me.
lines.zh: : 这听起来是一场非常绕的课。

lines.en: : It is. So ask your mom if you really want to know. You heard my sister. She doesn’t hate you.
lines.zh: : 是很绕。所以你要是真想知道,就去问你妈妈。你也听见我姐的话了。她不恨你。

lines.en: : Maybe “hate” is too strong of a word, but...
lines.zh: : 也许「恨」这个字太重了,但是……

lines.en: : She certainly doesn’t want me. She basically told me outright.
lines.zh: : 她肯定不想要我。她基本是明说了。

lines.en: : Tsukasa...
lines.zh: : Tsukasa……

lines.en: : But that’s okay! Tsukasa Tsukioka is stronger and smarter and more mature than anyone gives her credit for! She’ll prove to everybody just how valuable she is! Mark my...her words!
lines.zh: : 但没关系!Tsukasa Tsukioka 比任何人以为的都更坚强、更聪明、更成熟!她会向所有人证明她多有价值!记……她的话!

lines.en: : That just makes Chinami feel bad, so she’s decided to take you off her shit list until you can get back on your feet.
lines.zh: : 这反而让 Chinami 难受,所以她决定把你移出黑名单——直到你重新振作为止。

lines.en: : Nonsense, Chinami!
lines.zh: : 胡说,Chinami!

lines.en: : I’ve never been more confident in my future than I am right now!
lines.zh: : 我对我的未来,从来没有像此刻这样自信过!

lines.en: Life for Tsukasa Tsukioka was looking up all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : Tsukasa Tsukioka 的人生,突然一片光明!

lines.en: What could possibly go wrong?
lines.zh: : 还能出什么岔子?

lines.en: Tsukasa’s affection has increased to [tsukasa_love]!
lines.zh: Tsukasa 的好感度提升到了 [tsukasa_love]!
